title: Adaptive-capacity embedding plus Mirror view
hypothesis: For low-frequency tokens represented by a shared low-dimensional adaptive embedding, a small token coordinate selecting a structured orthogonal view can improve rare-token quality at lower actual bytes than simply allocating each rare token more physical dimensions.
physical_object: frequency-banded embedding with 16D common-token vectors and 4D rare-token vectors
mirror_coordinate: one learned Givens angle per rare token rotating two shared latent 2D components before a fixed shared 4D-to-16D projection
logical_multiplicity: 128 token embeddings, 96 in the low-capacity rare band

model.data: Synthetic frequency-skewed token classification. Common tokens receive 8x the training examples of rare tokens. Rare teacher embeddings are generated by a shared projection of two token-shared 2D latent components under a token-specific Givens coordinate. Same labels/examples are provided across controls.

controls: native adaptive 16D common + 4D rare embeddings and shared projection
equal-byte native adaptive allocation with rare width increased to match Mirror payload bytes
adaptive 4D rare basis plus per-token Mirror Givens code
adaptive 4D rare basis plus per-token scalar gate control
development_gate_before_fresh: Both development seeds: full-table rare accuracy >=0.75; Mirror rare-token accuracy within 0.02 of full table; Mirror rare-token accuracy >=0.05 absolute above native 4D adaptive; actual payload <=0.90x equal-byte native width-allocation control and <=0.60x full table; report common/rare NLL, bytes, and embedding uniqueness; serialized CPU throughput >=0.90x fastest native adaptive control. Fresh remains sealed if any condition misses.
success_gate: All three fresh worlds pass rare/common quality, actual bytes, uniqueness, runtime and exact replay; Mirror improves adaptive embedding quality-byte frontier over direct dimension allocation.
failure_gate: Any development world misses a registered gate or native dimension allocation matches Mirror at lower/equal bytes.

storage.authority: actual deterministic ZIP/NPY FP16 inference payload after reload

boundaries: synthetic teacher is aligned to Mirror family
logical vocabulary size is not independent capacity
fresh worlds stay sealed until all dev gates pass
